purpose: Observe a modern same-model Repo2Run baseline on the complete fixed CrossMethod-9 development stratum and compare its Official outcomes and failure distribution with EnvSolve-Pro A/B. This is not part of the paired Minimal-B treatment estimate.

selection.rule: Use all nine cases in the already fixed source-census order; do not select by current A/B outcomes.

baseline.existing_benchmark_adapter: Distill replayable environment actions into the same open-program and Official EnvBench interface used by the prior cross-method census. Unsupported source-edit actions remain observable candidate-formation failures.

budgets.interpretation: Success is primary. Token and cost use are measured outcomes; the deliberately remote caps are only runaway-process protection.

endpoints.primary: EnvBench Official Pass@1 per case and aggregate descriptive pass rate
endpoints.failure: Earliest decisive Observation, Constraint, or Operation layer plus infrastructure/protocol censoring

claim_boundary: The batch can update the development failure census and provide a same-model external baseline.
It is unpaired and stochastic, so it cannot estimate the Minimal-B causal effect.
It is consumed development evidence and cannot establish held-out generalization, leaderboard performance, SOTA, or statistical significance.
Do not change cases, provider, inference contract, baseline algorithm, or adapter after observing any current outcome.
